description: Open positions of traders with a winning record, biggest first: the market, the side, what they paid, what it costs now, the lead holder and the others. The best answer to "what are winning traders holding". Each holder counts as one row toward the 5,000 trades a day.

backed.description: Only sides whose record backs buying at today's price.

category.description: Market categories to include. Omit for all.

day.description: Only markets whose game is played today, tomorrow or this week (US Eastern). Season-long markets have no day and are left out.

kind.description: Kinds of market, e.g. nba, nfl, soccer, fed_rates. Omit for all.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

market.description: Market refs, from search_markets or a trade row.

minTraders.description: Only sides at least this many winning traders hold.

outcome.description: A side by its name ("Yes", "Lakers", "Up"). Needs exactly one market.

trader.description: Trader refs (venue:id), from search_traders or a trade row.

venue.description: Venues to include. Omit for all.

name: get_positions

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page. Null on the last page.

title: Winning traders' open positions
